title: Cosmic Octopus Dreamscape
description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large pink cartoon octopus with big eyes floating on a grassy island in the night sky. Below, a white human figure stands in a dark reflective pond with arms raised, creating ripples, while a patterned tie-dye banner with animal silhouettes cracks across the starry cosmic background filled with constellations and nebulae.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene with a cute pink octopus creature with large sparkling eyes floating on a grassy levitating island in a starry night sky. The octopus has two transparent bubbles above its head, one containing a galaxy and another a skull. A white human figure stands in a dark pond below with arms raised, creating concentric ripples. A large cracked tie-dye banner with pink and green spiral patterns and silhouettes of animals like deer, birds, and dogs stretches diagonally across the composition. Vibrant cosmic background with purple and green nebulae and constellations.
